assets.title: The Tisenjoch find area
assets.alt: A modern stone memorial among rocks in a high Alpine landscape
assets.caption: The modern memorial marks the Alpine setting where Ötzi was found in 1991.

assets.title: A reconstruction of Ötzi’s axe
assets.alt: A copper blade fixed into a wooden axe handle
assets.caption: A modern reconstruction shows how the copper blade sits in the wooden haft.

assets.title: Uummannaq and its fjord
assets.alt: Uummannaq’s buildings below a steep mountain beside the water in Greenland
assets.caption: Uummannaq is near Qilakitsoq, where Inuit graves were preserved in a cold and sheltered setting.

assets.title: A preserved Pazyryk carpet
assets.alt: A patterned carpet with a geometric centre and rows of figures around the border
assets.caption: Ice inside an Altai burial mound preserved this textile, now in the State Hermitage Museum.

assets.title: Llullaillaco from orbit
assets.alt: An astronaut’s photograph of the volcanic massif and surrounding high Andean landscape
assets.caption: Llullaillaco straddles the modern Argentina–Chile border. This astronaut photograph shows the surrounding mountain landscape.
assets.credit: NASA Johnson Space Center / ISS Expedition 22 crew, ISS022-E-8285

assets.title: Ampato, Peru
assets.alt: Snow-covered slopes on the Ampato volcanic massif
assets.caption: This photograph shows the high mountain landscape where Juanita and other Inca-period burials were found.

assets.title: Historic architectural engraving of Al-Masjid al-Haram and the Kaaba (1721)
assets.alt: Archival 18th-century engraving of Mecca sanctuary colonnades and the Kaaba.
assets.caption: Historical view of Al-Masjid al-Haram compiled in Fischer von Erlach's 1721 Entwurff einer Historischen Architektur.

assets.title: Nabataean rock-cut tomb at Hegra (Madāʾin Ṣāliḥ)
assets.alt: Carved sandstone facade set into desert rock outcrop at Hegra in Al-Ula, Saudi Arabia.
assets.caption: Hegra (Al-Hijr) preserves over 100 carved Nabataean tomb facades dated between 1 BCE and 75 CE.

assets.title: Taj Mahal mausoleum complex in Agra
assets.alt: White marble domes, minarets and reflective pool of the Taj Mahal in Agra, India.
assets.caption: Commissioned under Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan (1632–1648), blending Persianate charbagh geometry with pietra dura marble inlay.

assets.title: Lotus-bud towers of Angkor Wat, Cambodia
assets.alt: Sandstone towers of Angkor Wat mirrored in the foreground temple pond.
assets.caption: Built under Suryavarman II in the 12th century CE, Angkor Wat sits inside a moated Khmer stone and hydraulic network.

assets.title: Excavated warriors of Pit 1, Xi'an
assets.alt: Rows of life-sized terracotta soldiers standing in earthen trenches beneath an excavation hall in Xi'an.
assets.caption: Life-sized clay figures guarded the eastern approaches of Qin Shi Huang's mausoleum complex (~210 BCE).
assets.credit: Joe Hart from Southampton, United Kingdom

assets.title: Great Bath brickwork at Mohenjo-daro, Sindh
assets.alt: Sunken fired-brick pool surrounded by stepped stairs and drains at Mohenjo-daro, Pakistan.
assets.caption: Standardized baked brickwork and bitumen waterproofing demonstrate mature Indus urban hydrology (c. 2600–1900 BCE).

assets.title: Granite stelae at Aksum, northern Ethiopia
assets.alt: Carved monolithic Aksumite stone obelisks rising in the Northern Stelae Park.
assets.caption: Carved single-block nepheline-syenite stelae memorialized royal tombs during Aksum's classical third-to-fourth century peak.

assets.title: Cruciform Bete Giyorgis cut downward into basalt tuff
assets.alt: Overhead view into the sunken courtyard and cruciform roof of Bete Giyorgis in Lalibela, Ethiopia.
assets.caption: Monolithic church hollowed downward from a single volcanic scoria bedrock block in highland Ethiopia.

assets.title: Qutb Minar victory tower, Delhi
assets.alt: Fluted red-sandstone and marble tower surrounded by early Sultanate mosque ruins in Delhi.
assets.caption: Raised from the 1190s–1220s CE, marking early Delhi Sultanate sandstone and corbel-vault architecture alongside the Gupta-era Iron Pillar.

assets.title: Uluru sandstone massif in Anangu Country, Central Australia
assets.alt: Red arkosic sandstone monolith rising out of desert spinifex plains in the Northern Territory.
assets.caption: Every fissure and spring around Uluru carries Anangu Tjukurpa creation narratives including Kuniya, Liru, and the Mala ancestors.

assets.title: Brick monastic courtyards at Nālandā Mahāvihāra, Bihar
assets.alt: Excavated burnt-brick monastic cells, stupas, and walkways at Nalanda, eastern India.
assets.caption: Excavated residential monasteries studied by Xuanzang and Yijing between the 5th and 12th centuries CE.

assets.title: Sarsen lintels and trilithons at Stonehenge, Wiltshire
assets.alt: Standing megalithic sandstone pillars topped with fitted horizontal lintels on Salisbury Plain.
assets.caption: Interlocking mortise-and-tenon sarsen joints paired with Welsh bluestones raised across Neolithic–Early Bronze Age phases.

assets.title: Al-Khazneh carved facade emerging from the Siq, Petra
assets.alt: Rose-red cliff-carved pediment and Corinthian columns seen between narrow canyon walls in Petra, Jordan.
assets.caption: Nabataean hydraulic conduits lined the Siq canyon leading into Petra's ceremonial and civic basin.
assets.credit: Al_Khazneh_Petra.jpg : Graham Racher from London, UK derivative work: MrPanyGoff

assets.title: Trilingual Rosetta Stone decodes Ptolemaic royal decree
assets.alt: Dark granodiorite stele inscribed in Hieroglyphic, Demotic, and Ancient Greek scripts.
assets.caption: Issued at Memphis in 196 BCE in three scripts, enabling Champollion's 1822 decipherment.

assets.title: Earthen adobe buttresses and toron timbers of Djinguereber Mosque, Timbuktu
assets.alt: Sun-baked clay walls studded with protruding wooden scaffolding timbers in Mali.
assets.caption: Built in the 14th century and replastered communally before annual rains by Timbuktu's masons.

assets.title: Porites coral arches of the Great Mosque of Kilwa Kisiwani, Tanzania
assets.alt: Arched domed coral-stone bays overlooking coastal palm ruins at Kilwa Kisiwani.
assets.caption: Dressed submarine Porites coral and lime mortar vaulted the Swahili Coast's monumental 14th-century congregational mosque.

assets.title: Steep-sided sandstone pyramids of Meroë, Sudan
assets.alt: Cluster of Kushite sandstone pyramid superstructures rising across desert dunes along the Nile.
assets.caption: Meroitic Kushite rulers raised steep sandstone mortuary pyramids paired with Indigenous Meroitic inscriptions and iron-slag mounds.

assets.title: Great Hypostyle Hall sandstone columns at Karnak, Luxor
assets.alt: Towering papyriform sandstone capitals carved with sunken hieroglyphic registers at Karnak.
assets.caption: New Kingdom state temple complex anchoring Theban astronomy, Nile flood festivals, and royal relief annals.

assets.title: Seaside vaulted ruins of the Antonine Baths at Carthage, Tunisia
assets.alt: Limestone columns and seaside bath foundations overlooking the Gulf of Tunis.
assets.caption: Roman re-monumentalization along the maritime shore above older Punic harbors and residential quarters.

assets.title: Carved limestone T-pillars inside Enclosure D at Göbekli Tepe
assets.alt: Circular subterranean stone wall framing tall monolithic T-shaped limestone pillars in southeastern Anatolia.
assets.caption: Late Pre-Pottery Neolithic hunter-gatherer builders carved monumental animal reliefs centuries before settled cereal villages dominated the plateau.

assets.title: Acropolis hill and marble Parthenon from Philopappos, Athens
assets.alt: Fortified limestone acropolis crowned by Classical marble temples above the Athens basin.
assets.caption: Classical Fifth-century BCE civic acropolis sitting over Mycenaean Bronze Age fortification traces.

assets.title: Travertine arches of the Flavian Amphitheatre (Colosseum), Rome
assets.alt: Tiered travertine arcade rising above exposed brick and tufa substructures in Rome.
assets.caption: Engineered with concrete vaults and travertine piers to host civic spectacles at the heart of the early Empire.

assets.title: Volcanic andesite lattice stupas atop Borobudur, Central Java
assets.alt: Perforated bell-shaped stone stupas framing mountain volcanic horizons on Java.
assets.caption: Nine-tiered Sailendra stepped mandala constructed without mortar from interlocking volcanic andesite blocks.

assets.title: Tang dynasty mural of Zhang Qian’s mission (Mogao Cave 323, Dunhuang)
assets.alt: Historic Tang wall painting depicting Emperor Han Wudi bidding farewell to imperial envoy Zhang Qian.
assets.caption: Tang Buddhists in Dunhuang painted Zhang Qian’s 2nd-century BCE Central Asian journey along the Silk Road corridor.

assets.title: 15th-century Ming painting of the giraffe presented during Zheng He’s voyages
assets.alt: Early Ming ink-and-color scroll depicting a tall giraffe guided by an attendant in court robes.
assets.caption: Envoys connected with Zheng He’s fourth treasure fleet brought an East African giraffe via Bengal to Beijing in 1414 CE.

assets.title: Leather manuscript fragment (Pesher Isaiah) from Qumran Cave 4
assets.alt: Inked Hebrew square-script leather columns preserved inside arid Judean desert caves.
assets.caption: Hellenistic–Roman period Dead Sea manuscripts attest diverse Second Temple Jewish texts centuries older than medieval codices.

assets.title: Classical striated lost-wax cast head from Ilé-Ifẹ̀, Nigeria
assets.alt: Finely modeled West African bronze/brass royal portrait with beaded crown and facial striations.
assets.caption: Ilé-Ifẹ̀ stands both as archaeological artistic pinnacle and sacred Yoruba cradle where Odùduwà and Ọbàtálá shaped earth and life.

assets.title: Basalt Piedra del Sol (Aztec Sun Stone) showing the Fifth Sun cosmology
assets.alt: Detailed close-up of carved Mexica basalt calendar medallions representing previous cosmic Suns.
assets.caption: Basalt sculpture encoding Mexica cosmology of four doomed cosmic Suns preceding the current Fifth Sun (Nahui Ollin).

assets.title: Great Sphinx and Old Kingdom pyramid plateau at Giza
assets.alt: Carved limestone Great Sphinx framed against Old Kingdom stepped-and-smooth Giza pyramids.
assets.caption: Old Kingdom Fourth Dynasty limestone quarrying and royal mortuary cosmology centered adjacent to Heliopolis and Memphis.

assets.title: Upper Paleolithic pigment panel (Lascaux Cave, Hall of the Bulls)
assets.alt: Paleolithic mineral-pigment horses and cattle across the curving white calcite wall of Lascaux Cave
assets.caption: Charcoal, manganese oxide and red-yellow ochre figures sweep across the Hall of the Bulls at Lascaux (~17,000–15,000 BCE).

assets.title: Archaeological complex at Bolgar overlooking the Middle Volga River
assets.alt: Stone foundations and reconstructed monument domes on the high bank of the Volga near Kazan.
assets.caption: Medieval Volga Bulgar settlement downstream of Kazan anchored the 922 CE Abbasid diplomatic mission of Ahmad ibn Fadlan.

assets.title: Dry-stone granite masonry inside Great Zimbabwe’s Great Enclosure
assets.alt: Uncemented curved granite block wall wrapping the conical stone tower in southeastern Zimbabwe.
assets.caption: Over 900,000 split granite blocks fitted without mortar showcase Shona civic engineering and gold–ivory trade prestige.
assets.credit: Andrew Moore from Johannesburg, South Africa

assets.title: Restored Najdi mud-brick palaces in At-Turaif, ad-Diriyah
assets.alt: Cream-colored earthen walls pierced with triangular ventilation vents along Wadi Hanifah.
assets.caption: Capital of the First Saudi State (1727/1744–1818 CE), built in characteristic Najdi adobe and tamarisk-beam architecture.

assets.title: Isla del Sol terraces rising from Lake Titicaca, Bolivia
assets.alt: High-altitude azure waters of Lake Titicaca framed by stone-terraced hillsides.
assets.caption: Pan-Andean cosmology locates Viracocha’s rising from chaos at Lake Titicaca to summon sun, moon, and sculpted nations.

assets.title: Persepolis Apadana limestone reliefs, Fars, Iran
assets.alt: Carved limestone stairs and fluted columns of the Achaemenid Apadana terrace at Persepolis.
assets.caption: Fifth-century BCE Achaemenid ceremonial complex recorded at Takht-e Jamshid (Persepolis).

assets.title: Blue glazed-brick reliefs from the Ishtar Gate of Babylon
assets.alt: Molded glazed bricks showing bulls and mushkhushshu dragons from Neo-Babylonian Babylon.
assets.caption: Rebuilt under Nebuchadnezzar II (c. 575 BCE), pairing monumental brick glaze with cuneiform foundation records.
assets.credit: unknown artist Details on Google Art Project

assets.title: Sudano-Sahelian earthen architecture of Historic Djenné, Mali
assets.alt: Monumental adobe facade with toron scaffolding poles in the Inland Niger Delta.
assets.caption: Living mud-brick masonry tradition situated three kilometres from ancient archaeological mounds at Jenné-jeno.

assets.title: Tāne Mahuta giant kauri tree in Waipoua Forest, Aotearoa
assets.alt: Towering ancient kauri trunk rising inside dense New Zealand temperate rainforest.
assets.caption: Named for Tāne-mahuta, forest deity who in Māori whakapapa pushed apart Sky Father Ranginui and Earth Mother Papatūānuku to admit light.

assets.title: Late Bronze Age copper oxhide ingot from Mediterranean shipwreck archaeology
assets.alt: Four-handled cast metallic copper ingot recovered from underwater Mediterranean excavations.
assets.caption: Standardized copper and tin ingots traced Mediterranean maritime circuits across Cyprus, the Levant, and the Aegean.

assets.title: Steppe perimeter of Karakorum and Erdene Zuu, Mongolia
assets.alt: Whitewashed stupa walls bordering the Orkhon Valley plains near medieval Karakorum.
assets.caption: Imperial Mongol capital anchored in the Orkhon Valley steppe landscape before post-imperial monastic construction.

assets.title: Middle-to-Lower Congo River rapids corridor
assets.alt: Broad rushing rapids of the Congo River dividing navigable inner basin reaches from Atlantic gorges.
assets.caption: Cataracts below Malebo Pool split interior river canoe highways from Atlantic coastal ports until colonial rail and steam networks.

assets.title: Chola granite tower of Brihadeeswarar Temple, Thanjavur (c. 1010 CE)
assets.alt: Carved granite pyramidal sanctuary tower capped by an octagonal stone cupola at Thanjavur.
assets.caption: Rajaraja Chola I commissioned this monumental granite temple and covered its base in Tamil administrative and agrarian inscriptions.
assets.credit: Original: Rainer Halama Derivative work: UnpetitproleX

assets.title: Antikythera Mechanism main bronze gear fragment (c. 70–60 BCE wreck)
assets.alt: Close view of the corroded bronze gears and engraved plates of the Antikythera Mechanism Fragment A in Athens.
assets.caption: Fragment A of the Antikythera Mechanism recovered from the c. 70–60 BCE shipwreck off Antikythera, Greece.

assets.title: Oseberg clinker-built oak Viking ship (834 CE burial)
assets.alt: Preserved carved prow and overlapping clinker hull strakes of the 9th-century Oseberg ship in Oslo.
assets.caption: Excavated in Vestfold, Norway, the 21.5-meter Oseberg oak ship shows overlapping iron-riveted clinker strake engineering.

assets.title: Reassembled 1380 Bremen Hanseatic Cog in Bremerhaven
assets.alt: Wide oak cargo hull and sternpost rudder assembly of the 1380 Bremen Cog on display indoors.
assets.caption: Felled in autumn 1378 CE and lost c. 1380 in a Weser flood, the Bremen Cog preserved northern European bulk cargo construction intact.

assets.title: Tang Changsha stoneware bowl recovered from the Belitung shipwreck (c. 826 CE)
assets.alt: Glazed ninth-century Tang Dynasty Changsha ceramic bowl salvaged from the Belitung dhow off Sumatra.
assets.caption: One of tens of thousands of Changsha export bowls carried aboard an Abbasid/Indian coconut-coir sewn dhow wrecked off Belitung around 826–830 CE.

assets.title: Satellite view of North Sentinel Island and uplifted fringing reefs
assets.alt: NASA EO-1 true-color satellite view of forested North Sentinel Island surrounded by exposed bright coral reefs and breaking surf.
assets.caption: NASA Earth Observatory image highlighting North Sentinel Island's forest interior and uplifted western/southern coral reef platforms.
assets.credit: NASA Earth Observatory image created by Jesse Allen, using data provided by the NASA EO-1 team.

assets.title: Andaman Archipelago across the Bay of Bengal (NASA MODIS)
assets.alt: Cloud-free satellite mosaic of North, Middle, South, and Little Andaman islands plus outlying North Sentinel Island in the Andaman Sea.
assets.caption: NASA MODIS regional satellite view situating North Sentinel Island west of South Andaman and north of Little Andaman in the Bay of Bengal.

assets.title: Ernest Shackleton's Endurance frozen in Weddell Sea pack ice (Frank Hurley, 1915)
assets.alt: Three-masted barquentine Endurance gripped by broken Weddell Sea pressure ridges at sunrise in 1915.
assets.caption: Frank Hurley's 1915 photograph of Endurance beset in Antarctica's Weddell Sea pack ice before crushing and sinking to 3,008 m (located intact March 2022).

assets.title: Raised 1628 Swedish royal warship Vasa inside the Vasa Museum, Stockholm
assets.alt: Port flank and high poop deck of the 17th-century oak galleon Vasa standing intact inside the Stockholm museum.
assets.caption: Capsized 1,300 m into its maiden sail on 10 August 1628 and lifted 98% original timber in 1961 after brackish Baltic waters prevented shipworm decay.

assets.title: Carved royal coat-of-arms lion sculptures on Vasa's towering stern (1628)
assets.alt: High oak stern gallery of the Vasa bearing ornate carved lions, knights, and Swedish royal heraldry.
assets.caption: Lavish top-heavy upperworks and dual gun decks pushed Vasa's center of gravity fatally high for open gunports.

assets.title: Four-masted barque Peter Iredale wrecked beside the Columbia River Bar (1906)
assets.alt: Rusted iron bow ribs of the 1906 British steel barque Peter Iredale sticking out of Oregon's Clatsop surf.
assets.caption: Stranded on Clatsop Spit south of the Columbia River Bar ('Graveyard of the Pacific') in dense coastal swell and gale on 25 October 1906.

assets.title: SS Eduard Bohlen stranded in desert sands along Namibia's Skeleton Coast (1909)
assets.alt: Corroding hull of the 1909 German liner Eduard Bohlen surrounded entirely by shifting Namib sand dunes far from the shoreline.
assets.caption: Wrecked in Benguela cold-current fog in September 1909; desert dune migration now leaves the hull hundreds of meters inland.

assets.title: Cape Hatteras Lighthouse above Diamond Shoals, North Carolina (US NPS)
assets.alt: Spiral-striped masonry lighthouse tower beside Atlantic Outer Banks dunes.
assets.caption: Built to warn shipping off treacherous Diamond Shoals where the Gulf Stream and Labrador Current collide across North Carolina's Outer Banks.

assets.title: Deep cobalt-blue lazurite from Sar-i Sang Mines, Badakhshan, Afghanistan
assets.alt: Polished deep ultramarine-blue mineral specimen dotted with golden pyrite from Sar-i Sang quarries.
assets.caption: Quarried above 3,000 m in Afghanistan's Hindu Kush for >6,000 years, this mineral traveled 5,000 km west as Renaissance painters' prized pigment ultramarine.

assets.title: Spiny dye-murex shell (Bolinus brandaris), source of Royal Tyrian Purple
assets.alt: Spined cream-tan Mediterranean sea snail shell photographed in two views.
assets.caption: Bronze and Iron Age Phoenician workshops crushed ~10,000 Mediterranean Murex snails per gram of non-fading purple dibromoindigo dye.

assets.title: Mexican cochineal scale insects (Dactylopius coccus) farmed on Opuntia cactus
assets.alt: White cottony insect clusters oozing bright carmine crimson on a green prickly-pear cactus pad.
assets.caption: Mixtec and Zapotec domestication of cochineal scale insects produced Europe's most coveted crimson textile dye under strict colonial Spanish monopoly.

assets.title: Yuan Dynasty Jingdezhen underglaze cobalt blue-and-white porcelain vase
assets.alt: Museum porcelain vase painted with intricate cobalt-blue floral motifs over white kaolin body.
assets.caption: Fourteenth-century fusion of Jingdezhen's white kaolin-petuntse porcelain body and imported Persian Kashan cobalt oxide pigment.

assets.title: Tang Dynasty three-color (sancai) lead-glazed stoneware Bactrian camel
assets.alt: Amber, green, and cream glazed pottery Bactrian camel from Tang Dynasty China.
assets.caption: High-temperature Chinese kiln mastery combined cosmopolitan Silk Road forms with vivid cobalt, copper-green, and iron-amber mineral glazes.

assets.title: Late 13th-century Heilongjiang bronze hand cannon (earliest surviving firearm family)
assets.alt: Corroded cylindrical Yuan-era cast-bronze hand cannon barrel with socket handle.
assets.caption: Excavated in Acheng, Heilongjiang (~1288 CE context), exemplifying the cast-metal gun barrels invented in China decades before Europe's 1326 cannon records.

assets.title: Trebucheted gunpowder-bomb illustration from Jiao Yu's Huolongjing
assets.alt: Classical Chinese woodblock illustration depicting an explosive bomb launched from a crouched-tiger siege catapult.
assets.caption: Ming-era military manual preserving late Song and Yuan siege-bomb and rocket engineering traditions.

assets.title: Three-tiered Pont du Gard Roman aqueduct bridge across the Gardon River, France
assets.alt: Three-story limestone arch bridge carrying Rome's 50-kilometer Uzès–Nîmes water channel across a green river gorge.
assets.caption: Completed in the mid-1st century CE without mortar in its upper tiers, sustaining Nemausus (Nîmes) along a gentle ~34 cm/km gravity gradient.

assets.title: Surviving polygonal basalt pavement of the Via Appia Antica south of Rome
assets.alt: Fitted gray volcanic stone road surface bordered by cypresses and ancient roadside funerary tombs.
assets.caption: Begun in 312 BCE under Appius Claudius Caecus, the 'Queen of Roads' pioneered Rome's >80,000-km imperial paved trunk road system.

assets.title: Hadrian's Wall sandstone curtain and Milecastle 39 along Northumberland ridges
assets.alt: Low stone Roman wall snaking along windswept green crags with a rectangular milecastle gateway.
assets.caption: Constructed from 122 CE across Britain's narrow Tyne–Solway neck to monitor northern movement, collect customs, and patrol frontier approaches.

assets.title: Triple Land Walls of Theodosius II in Constantinople (Istanbul)
assets.alt: Alternating limestone ashlar and red-brick defensive towers and battlements along Istanbul's historic land rampart.
assets.caption: Erected in 408–413 CE, Constantinople's triple defense network protected Eastern Rome through a millennium of sieges until May 1453.

assets.title: Charcoal horse heads panel (Chauvet-Pont-d'Arc replica)
assets.alt: Closely spaced overlapping charcoal horse profiles shaded across pale undulating cave limestone
assets.caption: Aurignacian artists blended stump-shaded charcoal profiles and surface scraping at Chauvet (~35,000–28,000 BCE; replica panel).

assets.title: Polychrome Magdalenian bison (Cave of Altamira, Spain)
assets.alt: Red ochre and black charcoal steppe bison curling dynamically on an uneven cave ceiling
assets.caption: Artists at Altamira exploited natural rock bosses on the ceiling to model curled steppe bison in black charcoal and warm red ochre.

assets.title: Open-air schist engravings at Canada do Inferno (Côa Valley, Portugal)
assets.alt: Weathered vertical schist riverside rock face incised with overlapping prehistoric animal outlines
assets.caption: Over thousands of meters along open river schist cliffs, Upper Paleolithic artists pecked intertwined horses, aurochs and ibex in daylight.

assets.title: Bronze Age granite petroglyphs at Vitlycke / Lövåsen (Tanum, Sweden)
assets.alt: Sunlit coastal granite slab carved with Nordics ships, animals and warrior figures highlighted in red
assets.caption: Smooth ice-polished granite bedrock at UNESCO-listed Tanum carries hundreds of Bronze Age ships, sun wheels, weapons and figures.

assets.title: Gobustan limestone petroglyphs (Caspian shore, Azerbaijan)
assets.alt: Dark limestone boulder face incised with stylized elongated human silhouettes and geometric boat motifs
assets.caption: Collapsed coastal boulders overlooking the Caspian Sea carry >6,000 Epipaleolithic-to-Iron Age dancers, reed boats and aurochs.

assets.title: Pleistocene red-ochre hand stencils (Leang Pettakere, Maros-Pangkep, Sulawesi)
assets.alt: Cluster of reddish-mulberry negative human handprints blown onto grey karst cave rock
assets.caption: Uranium-series speleothem crusts date Maros-Pangkep negative hand stencils and pig-deer paintings past ~40,000–51,200 years ago.

assets.title: Painted quartzite rock shelter (Bhimbetka, Madhya Pradesh, India)
assets.alt: White and red painted hunters, riders and forest animals across a rough sandstone shelter ceiling
assets.caption: Stratified quartzite shelters along the Vindhya Hills hold Mesolithic-through-Historic red, white and green mineral paintings.

assets.title: X-ray & ancestral figures at Anbangbang Rock Shelter (Kakadu, Australia)
assets.alt: Richly painted orange, yellow and white Aboriginal rock-art spirits and figures inside Anbangbang Shelter in Kakadu National Park
assets.caption: Overlapping red, yellow and white Bininj/Mungguy rock paintings at Anbangbang record ancestral Creation figures and estuarine game.

assets.title: Coastal gabbro petroglyphs at Murujuga (Burrup Peninsula, Western Australia)
assets.alt: Dark red-brown Pilbara boulder closely pecked with ancient Aboriginal kangaroo and stylized human petroglyphs
assets.caption: Murujuga's deep-gorge ironstone boulders carry over a million Aboriginal engravings spanning millennia of changing sea levels.

assets.title: Bronze Age canyon petroglyphs at Tamgaly (Semirechye, Kazakhstan)
assets.alt: Dark varnished sandstone gorge cliff incised with Bronze Age solar-headed beings, horses and wild cattle
assets.caption: Steep dark sandstone ledges inside Tamgaly Gorge gather ~5,000 Bronze Age steppe solar deities, chariots, bulls and ritual dancers.

assets.title: Stencil hand gallery at Cueva de las Manos (Río Pinturas, Patagonia, Argentina)
assets.alt: Polychrome Patagonian canyon overhang packed with red, white, yellow and black stenciled left hands
assets.caption: Hundreds of negative handprints sprayed through hollow bone tubes layer across ~9,300–1,300 BP hunter-gatherer canyon walls.

assets.title: Red-ochre Nordeste Tradition paintings at Serra da Capivara (Piauí, Brazil)
assets.alt: Warm sandstone shelter wall filled with small vivid red leaping deer, geometric trees and human dances
assets.caption: Pedra Furada and sister sandstone overhangs preserve lively Holocene red-ochre deer, dancers and hunting tableaux across Piauí.

assets.title: Amazonian tepui rock art panel (Serranía de Chiribiquete, Colombia)
assets.alt: Crimson mineral paintings on an Amazonian sandstone cliff showing geometric dancers and savanna-forest wildlife
assets.caption: Tepui cliff overhangs across Chiribiquete–La Lindosa record >75,000 ochre paintings from Terminal Pleistocene fauna onward.

assets.title: Stratified Middle Stone Age ochre-processing layers (Blombos Cave, South Africa)
assets.alt: Excavated sandy-ash occupation layers inside Blombos Cave tagged for microstratigraphic analysis
assets.caption: Still Bay layers (~77–73 ka) inside Blombos Cave yielded red ochre processing toolkits, pierced Nassarius shells and cross-hatched ochre engravings.

assets.title: Shaded polychrome San eland paintings (Maloti-Drakensberg, South Africa)
assets.alt: Delicately shaded golden-ochre and white eland antelopes painted on Cave Sandstone shelter wall
assets.caption: High Cave Sandstone overhangs in the Drakensberg shelter finely shaded polychrome eland central to San cosmology and healing.

assets.title: Sandstone giraffe & track engravings (Twyfelfontein / ǀUi-ǁAes, Namibia)
assets.alt: Red-brown Etjo sandstone boulder deeply engraved with a reticulated giraffe and animal footprints
assets.caption: More than 2,500 petroglyphs around Twyfelfontein desert spring depict giraffes, rhinos, ostriches and diagnostic spoor.

assets.title: Green Sahara pastoral cattle & figures (Tassili n'Ajjer, Algeria)
assets.alt: Yellow, white and red-ochre cattle herds and slender human herders painted across Sahara sandstone shelter
assets.caption: Wet-Holocene Round Head and Bovine Pastoral artists recorded flourishing Saharan savannas and long-horned herds atop the Tassili plateau.

assets.title: Humid-Sahara pastoralist & hunting paintings (Tadrart Acacus, Libya)
assets.alt: Red and white rock paintings under an Acacus sandstone overhang showing running archers and livestock
assets.caption: Sheltered wadi alcoves across Tadrart Acacus link Round Head murals, early plant pottery, and fifth-millennium BCE Saharan dairying.

assets.title: Floating figures & archers at Wadi Sura (Gilf Kebir, SW Egypt)
assets.alt: Small red-ochre human figures in arched floating posture painted across a rough sandstone alcove
assets.caption: Mid-Holocene Gilf Kebir shelters depict thousands of hand stencils, headless beasts, archers and floating or 'swimming' figures.

assets.title: Life-sized engraved giraffes at Dabous (Aïr Mountains, Niger)
assets.alt: Two monumental giraffes carved onto an inclined Saharan sandstone outcrop with speckled coats
assets.caption: Over five meters tall from hoof to ossicone, the Dabous Giraffes stand among the world's largest surviving Neolithic animal petroglyphs.

assets.title: Vibrant polychrome cattle & worshippers at Laas Geel (Somaliland)
assets.alt: Bright red, white and black granite overhang ceiling covered with ceremonial decorated cattle and human figures
assets.caption: Protected beneath granite overhangs near Hargeisa, Laas Geel preserves gleaming Ethiopian-Arabian style cattle robes and herdsmen.

assets.title: Geometric red & white Nyau shelter paintings (Chongoni, Malawi)
assets.alt: Granite cliff shelter featuring layered white-clay stylized designs over older red BaTwa lines
assets.caption: UNESCO-listed Chongoni overlays ancient BaTwa hunter-forager red geometrics with historic Chewa white-clay Nyau ritual symbols.

assets.title: Monumental sandstone engravings at Jubbah (Ḥāʾil, Saudi Arabia)
assets.alt: Desert sandstone cliff face carved with long-horned ibex and ancient human figures at Jebel Umm Sinman
assets.caption: Around an extinct Nafud paleolake, Jubbah and Shuwaymis cliff walls track Terminal Pleistocene hunters into Chalcolithic caravans.

assets.title: Lime-plaster Pre-Pottery Neolithic human statue (ʿAin Ghazal, Jordan)
assets.alt: Seventh-millennium BCE sculpted human figure modeled in pale lime plaster over a reed core with wide bitumen-ringed eyes
assets.caption: Cached c. 6700–6500 BCE at the 15-hectare settlement of ʿAin Ghazal, reed-and-plaster statues number among the earliest monumental human figures.

assets.title: Polychrome Neolithic interior house mural (Çatalhöyük, Anatolia)
assets.alt: Reconstructed red-ochre and black interior plaster wall mural from Çatalhöyük showing human hunters surrounding wild deer and boar
assets.caption: Dense mudbrick houses at seventh-millennium BCE Çatalhöyük brought hunting, vulture and bull imagery directly onto plastered domestic walls.

assets.title: Investiture Palace wall mural (Mari / Tell Hariri, Syria)
assets.alt: Bronze Age mineral-pigment fresco from Mari Royal Palace depicting date palms, mythic sphinxes and a Mesopotamian ruler
assets.caption: Surviving gypsum-plaster palace frescoes (~18th century BCE) preserve royal desert-river iconography along the Middle Euphrates.

assets.title: Stratified Dilmun harbor tell and sea fortress (Qalʿat al-Bahrain)
assets.alt: Sunlit ashlar limestone seawalls and excavated Bronze–Iron Age strata at the ancient Dilmun harbor mound
assets.caption: From ~2300 BCE onward, Qalʿat al-Bahrain anchored maritime trade connecting Sumer, Omani Magan copper and the Indus Valley.

assets.title: Pit-and-groove & curvilinear basalt boulder at Grimes Point (Nevada)
assets.alt: Dark volcanic basalt boulder along an ancient Lake Lahontan shoreline incised with pale geometric ovals and wavy grooves
assets.caption: Basalt boulders and low overhangs near Hidden Cave bear stratified Great Basin Curvilinear and Archaic pit-and-groove engravings.

assets.title: Desert-varnished Aztec sandstone panels at Valley of Fire (Nevada)
assets.alt: Red-orange sandstone cliff coated in dark patina carved with bighorn sheep, spirals and atlatl figures
assets.caption: Shaded sandstone overhangs in southern Nevada combine Desert Archaic dart-throwers, Ancestral Puebloan figures and Southern Paiute motifs.
assets.credit: InSapphoWeTrust from Los Angeles, California, USA

assets.title: Volcanic canyon panels at Sloan Canyon NCA (Southern Nevada)
assets.alt: Black desert-varnished dacite rock face pecked with geometric grids, horned figures and sheep south of Las Vegas
assets.caption: Over 300 volcanic gorge panels document Archaic, Patayan, Virgin Ancestral Puebloan and Southern Paiute imagery in southern Nevada.

assets.title: Coso Range basalt bighorn sheep panel (Western Great Basin, California)
assets.alt: Dark desert basalt rock wall packed with boat-bodied bighorn sheep and patterned anthropomorph petroglyphs
assets.caption: North America's densest bighorn-sheep petroglyph complex records late Holocene Coso–Numic hunting ritual and patterned-body shamans.

assets.title: Life-size Barrier Canyon Style spectral figures (Great Gallery, Utah)
assets.alt: Tall tapered armless red-ochre and white-stippled figures along the smooth Navajo Sandstone cliff wall of Horseshoe Canyon
assets.caption: OSL luminescence dating at the Great Gallery (Pederson et al. 2014) brackets iconic Barrier Canyon murals within ~1–1100 CE beside older Archaic panels.

assets.title: Superimposed Barrier Canyon, Fremont & Ute panels (Sego Canyon, Utah)
assets.alt: Towering red-and-white spectral anthropomorph paintings beneath Book Cliffs sandstone alongside pecked Fremont horns
assets.caption: Sego Canyon's Book Cliffs alcove displays three consecutive cultural art systems overlapping across a single sandstone wall.

assets.title: Fremont Great Hunt sandstone petroglyph panel (Nine Mile Canyon, Utah)
assets.alt: Detailed bighorn sheep herd and hunters with bows carved cleanly through dark canyon varnish in Nine Mile Canyon
assets.caption: Above Fremont granaries and pithouses, Nine Mile Canyon concentrates over 10,000 Fremont hunting scenes and horned serpents.

assets.title: Dense stratified desert-varnish palimpsest at Newspaper Rock (Bears Ears, Utah)
assets.alt: Dark iron-manganese cliff face densely packed with pale carved six-toed feet, deer, wheels and horsemen
assets.caption: Basketmaker, Ancestral Puebloan, Fremont, Ute and Diné passersby carved a dense multi-century graphic palimpsest into Wingate sandstone.

assets.title: Cliffside Ancestral Puebloan & Diné rock art (Canyon de Chelly, Arizona)
assets.alt: Vertical red canyon sandstone wall marked with Basketmaker, Puebloan and Diné rock-art paintings and glyphs
assets.caption: Canyon de Chelly's monumental cliff walls connect Basketmaker II alcoves and Pueblo ruins with historical Diné antelope-hunt murals.

assets.title: Polychrome astronomical sandstone cave ceiling (Chumash Painted Cave, California)
assets.alt: Dark sandstone cave ceiling illuminated with bright red, white and black sun discs, stars and aquatic Chumash forms
assets.caption: Chumash specialist artists painted vivid hematite, gypsum and charcoal astronomical mandalas inside sheltered coastal sandstone caves.
assets.credit: Doc Searls from Santa Barbara, USA

assets.title: Polychrome alcove pictograph at Carrizo Plain Painted Rock (California)
assets.alt: Weathered sandstone overhang wall preserving orange, white and black geometric Chumash–Yokuts pictographs
assets.caption: An isolated sandstone monolith on the Carrizo Plain shelters an amphitheater of Chumash, Yokuts and Salinan painted cosmology.
assets.credit: Pacific Southwest Region from Sacramento, US

assets.title: Giant desert-pavement scraped earth figure (Blythe Intaglios, California)
assets.alt: Colossal outstretched human outline scraped out of dark Colorado Desert gravel down to pale silt
assets.caption: Quechan and Mojave ancestors scraped colossal creator and mountain-lion intaglios across dark alluvial desert terraces along the Lower Colorado.

assets.title: Archaic Pecos River Style canyon shelter murals (Seminole Canyon, Texas)
assets.alt: Broad limestone canyon ceiling streaked with faded red-ochre anthropomorph silhouettes above rock-shelter terraces
assets.caption: Direct plasma-oxidation AMS dates in the Lower Pecos Canyonlands establish ~4,000 years of continuous polychrome cosmovision murals.

assets.title: Jornada Mogollon mountain-goat & mask boulders (Three Rivers, New Mexico)
assets.alt: Crisp stylized white-pecked desert bighorn sheep and geometric markings on dark reddish-brown basalt
assets.caption: More than 21,000 Jornada Mogollon carvings span basalt ridges above the Tularosa Basin between ~900 and 1400 CE.

assets.title: Rio Grande Style volcanic basalt carvings (Petroglyph National Monument, New Mexico)
assets.alt: Black volcanic boulders along West Mesa etched with Pueblo IV birds, spirals and ceremonial masks
assets.caption: Southern Tiwa and Puebloan artists carved >24,000 birds, stepped clouds, serpents and katsina masks along Albuquerque's basalt mesa.

assets.title: Jornada Mogollon red-ochre shelter pictograph (Hueco Tanks, Texas)
assets.alt: Fine red-ochre anthropomorph outlines and geometric rays painted across coarse orange syenite rock inside a Hueco Tanks recess
assets.caption: Rainwater syenite depressions at Hueco Tanks shelter over 200 Jornada Mogollon goggle-eyed masks and Apache paintings.

assets.title: Monochrome & bicolored canyon Great Mural (Sierra de San Francisco, Baja California)
assets.alt: Monumental red-and-black over-life-size human and leaping deer silhouettes across high Baja volcanic canyon overhang
assets.caption: UNESCO #714 protects hundreds of monumental Great Mural canyon overhangs painted ~5500 BCE – 1500 CE in Baja California Sur.

assets.title: Niitsítapi (Blackfoot) incised sandstone carvings (Writing-on-Stone / Áísínai'pi, Alberta)
assets.alt: Crisply incised Plains sandstone figures showing stylized horned beings and animals along the Milk River cliffs
assets.caption: UNESCO #1597 preserves sacred Milk River hoodoos holding millennia of Blackfoot vision-quest beings and historic biographic narratives.

assets.title: Anishinaabe red-ochre Mishipeshu cliff panel (Agawa Rock, Lake Superior)
assets.alt: Red iron-oxide paintings of horned Underwater Panther Mishipeshu, canoes and spirits on wave-lapped granite
assets.caption: Exposed granite ledges jutting over Lake Superior preserve Chief Myeengun's iconic crossing and Anishinaabe Midewiwin water spirits.

assets.title: Sioux quartzite ridge turtle & atlatl carvings (Jeffers Petroglyphs, Minnesota)
assets.alt: Glacial-smoothed rose-red quartzite bedrock carved with a sacred turtle figure and ancient lines
assets.caption: Over 5,000 carvings on tallgrass quartzite bridge Middle Archaic copper spear-points and atlatls to Dakota and Ioway sacred figures.

assets.title: Cherokee soapstone quarry boulder carvings (Judaculla Rock, North Carolina)
assets.alt: Close-up oblique view of the massive dark grey-green soapstone boulder densely carved with curved tracks, hands and arcs
assets.caption: Steatite bowl-quarry hollows from Late Archaic craftsmen share this Blue Ridge boulder with >1,500 Cherokee and Woodland sacred glyphs.

assets.title: Tlingit intertidal greywacke carvings (Petroglyph Beach, Wrangell, Alaska)
assets.alt: Mossy dark coastal boulder at low tide carved with bold spiral eye and face motifs of Tlingit crest art
assets.caption: Over forty tidal greywacke boulders near the Stikine River mouth bear ravens, whales, spirals and ancestor faces.

assets.title: Wandjina ancestral rain-spirit rock paintings (The Kimberley, Western Australia)
assets.alt: Luminous haloed white-and-ochre Wandjina faces with large dark eyes painted on a Kimberley sandstone ceiling
assets.caption: Ngarinyin, Wunambal and Worrorra galleries across the Kimberley celebrate supreme haloed Wandjina cloud and rain creators.

assets.title: Red-ochre giraffe & figure paintings (Kondoa Irangi, Tanzania)
assets.alt: Fine slender red-ochre giraffes and stretched hunter figures painted across weathered gneiss cliff overhang in Tanzania
assets.caption: More than 150 gneiss rock shelters across UNESCO-listed Kondoa stack ancient hunter-forager fine red lines beneath late white-paste cattle art.
